paragraphs.zh: (1)制备得到的2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸钠盐(98.2％，0.1mol)分八次加入反应瓶中，总加料时间为2h，加毕保温反应5h。反应完毕，负压脱溶，釜残加水120mL，搅拌溶解后滴加浓盐酸将体系pH值酸化至3，之后经过滤、水淋洗、烘干得到产物33.4g，HPLC定量得目标化合物2-氯-3-[(RS)-四氢呋喃-2-基甲氧基甲基]-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸含量为95.5％，以2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯计两步反应收率91.5％。
paragraphs.en: (1) The sodium 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoate obtained above (98.2％, 0.1 mol) was added into the reaction flask in eight portions, the total addition time being 2 h; after addition was complete the reaction was held at temperature for 5 h. When the reaction was complete the solvent was stripped under reduced pressure, 120 mL of water was added to the kettle residue, and after stirring to dissolve, concentrated hydrochloric acid was added dropwise to acidify the system to pH 3; then filtration, water rinsing and drying gave 33.4 g of product. HPLC quantification gave a content of 95.5％ of the target compound 2-chloro-3-[(RS)-tetrahydrofuran-2-ylmethoxymethyl]-4-methanesulfonylbenzoic acid, a two-step yield of 91.5％ based on methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoate.
paragraphs.notes: Unnumbered paragraph at the top of the page; it is the continuation of a paragraph that begins on the previous page, so its [00NN] marker is not printed here. It is the step (1)/(2) writeup of the preceding example, not of 实施例20 below.

paragraphs.zh: (1)与实施例1所述步骤相同，得到含量为98.2％的2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸钠盐；
paragraphs.en: (1) Following the same procedure as described in Example 1, sodium 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoate with a content of 98.2％ was obtained;

paragraphs.zh: (2)2-氯-3-[(RS)-四氢呋喃-2-基甲氧基甲基]-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸的制备，主要反应过程可以以如下反应方程式表示：
paragraphs.en: (2) Preparation of 2-chloro-3-[(RS)-tetrahydrofuran-2-ylmethoxymethyl]-4-methanesulfonylbenzoic acid; the main reaction process can be represented by the following reaction equation:

paragraphs.notes: This marker carries no text. It sits in the left margin and labels the reaction scheme drawing that occupies the rest of the line block.

paragraphs.zh: 向反应釜中加入100mL 2-四氢呋喃甲醇，开动搅拌，室温下投入5.5g金属钾(99％，0.14mol)，搅拌至溶解完全，经高真空油泵负压脱溶后得到2-四氢呋喃甲醇醇钾固体，密封备用。
paragraphs.en: 100 mL of 2-tetrahydrofurfuryl alcohol was charged into the reaction kettle, stirring was started, and 5.5 g of potassium metal (99％, 0.14 mol) was added at room temperature. The mixture was stirred until dissolution was complete, and after solvent stripping under reduced pressure with a high-vacuum oil pump, solid potassium 2-tetrahydrofurfuryl alkoxide was obtained, which was sealed and set aside for use.
paragraphs.notes: The text layer renders the quantity as "5 .5g" with a stray space; the printed page reads 5.5g.

paragraphs.zh: 向2-四氢呋喃甲醇醇钾中加入130mL乙腈，搅拌溶解后控制釜温在15℃，将步骤(1)制备得到的2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸钠盐(98.2％，0.1mol)分八次加入反应瓶中，总加料时间为1h，加毕保温反应6h。反应完毕，负压脱溶，釜残加水120mL，搅拌溶解后滴加浓盐酸将体系pH值酸化至2，之后经过滤、水淋洗、烘干得到产物32.6g，HPLC定量得目标化合物2-氯-3-[(RS)-四氢呋喃-2-基甲氧基甲基]-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸含量为97.0％，以2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯计两步反应收率90.8％。
paragraphs.en: 130 mL of acetonitrile was added to the potassium 2-tetrahydrofurfuryl alkoxide; after stirring to dissolve, the kettle temperature was controlled at 15℃, and the sodium 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoate prepared in step (1) (98.2％, 0.1 mol) was added into the reaction flask in eight portions, the total addition time being 1 h; after addition was complete the reaction was held at temperature for 6 h. When the reaction was complete the solvent was stripped under reduced pressure, 120 mL of water was added to the kettle residue, and after stirring to dissolve, concentrated hydrochloric acid was added dropwise to acidify the system to pH 2; then filtration, water rinsing and drying gave 32.6 g of product. HPLC quantification gave a content of 97.0％ of the target compound 2-chloro-3-[(RS)-tetrahydrofuran-2-ylmethoxymethyl]-4-methanesulfonylbenzoic acid, a two-step yield of 90.8％ based on methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoate.

paragraphs.zh: 申请人声明，本发明通过上述实施例来说明本发明的2-氯-3-烷氧基甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸的制备方法，具体指2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸和2-氯-3-[(RS)-四氢呋喃-2-基甲氧基甲基]-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸的制备方法，但本发明并不局限于上述详细方法，即不意味着本发明必须依赖上述详细方法才能实施。所属技术领域的技术人员应该明了，对本发明的任何改进，对本发明产品各原料的等效替换及辅助成分的添加、具体方式的选择等，均落在本发明的保护范围和公开范围之内。
paragraphs.en: The applicant declares that the present invention illustrates, through the above examples, the process of the present invention for preparing 2-chloro-3-alkoxymethyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoic acid, specifically the processes for preparing 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methanesulfonylbenzoic acid and 2-chloro-3-[(RS)-tetrahydrofuran-2-ylmethoxymethyl]-4-methanesulfonylbenzoic acid, but the present invention is not limited to the above detailed methods, i.e. it does not mean that the present invention must rely on the above detailed methods in order to be practised. Persons skilled in the art should understand that any improvement to the present invention, the equivalent replacement of each raw material of the product of the present invention, the addition of auxiliary components, the selection of specific modes and the like all fall within the scope of protection and the scope of disclosure of the present invention.

drawings.notes: Single-arrow scheme for step (2) of Example 20: displacement of the benzylic bromide by the potassium alkoxide, then acidification of the carboxylate salt to the free acid with HCl. Neither drawn structure carries a stereo bond or wedge at the tetrahydrofuran 2-position, so the drawing itself does not specify configuration; the prose names the product as the (RS) racemate. The tetrahydrofuran ring oxygen is drawn at the top of the ring in the reagent and at the lower right of the ring in the product, in both cases adjacent to the substituted carbon, so the substituent is at the 2-position in both.
